name: RTI-120
summary: RTI-120 ((–)-2β-carbophenoxy-3β-(p-tolyl)tropane or RTI-4229-120) is a phenyltropane derivative which acts as a reasonably selective dopamine reuptake inhibitor, along with weaker inhibition of noradrenaline and serotonin reuptake. It has a reasonably fast rate of occupancy of dopamine transporters in the brain, though slower than that of cocaine itself.

pharmacology.text: RTI-120 ((–)-2β-carbophenoxy-3β-(p-tolyl)tropane or RTI-4229-120) is a phenyltropane derivative which acts as a reasonably selective dopamine reuptake inhibitor, along with weaker inhibition of noradrenaline and serotonin reuptake. It has a reasonably fast rate of occupancy of dopamine transporters in the brain, though slower than that of cocaine itself.

summaryZh: RTI-120是一種含氮有機化合物，開發代號：RTI-4229-120，分子式C22H25NO2，可用作多巴胺再攝取抑制劑，同時對去甲腎上腺素和血清素的再攝取抑制作用較弱。
summaryZhHans: RTI-120是一种含氮有机化合物，开发代号：RTI-4229-120，分子式C22H25NO2，可用作多巴胺再摄取抑制剂，同时对去甲肾上腺素和血清素的再摄取抑制作用较弱。

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, anxiety, sleeplessness, overheating and paranoia, and repeated use can lead to compulsive redosing and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、焦慮、失眠、體溫過高和偏執，反覆使用可能導致強迫性追加和依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、高血压、焦虑、失眠、体温过高和偏执，反复使用可能导致强迫性追加和依赖。

fact.en: Many RTI compounds differ only in one small group on the ring or the ester, and comparing them showed chemists which parts of the molecule control which transporter it prefers.
fact.zh: 許多 RTI 化合物之間只差環上或酯基上的一個小基團，比較它們讓化學家看出分子的哪些部分決定它偏好哪種轉運蛋白。
fact.zhHans: 许多 RTI 化合物之间只差环上或酯基上的一个小基团，比较它们让化学家看出分子的哪些部分决定它偏好哪种转运蛋白。
